Subject: Ridgeway north depot downtime and Tuesday prep

Hi Carla,

Thanks for walking me through Ridgeway's setup today. Cutting downtime at the north depot is clearly the priority, and that's where Driftline can help most, with service scheduled ahead of time, parts on hand, and the right tech on the right truck.

Your CFO needs to see the numbers before Tuesday, so could we do a 20-minute call Monday? Bring whatever downtime and maintenance figures you have for the north depot, and we'll put together the one-page summary for your budget meeting.

[Your name]

Note: Replace [Your name] and confirm Monday works. I didn't draft the ROI one-pager itself because the notes have no downtime, cost, or fleet-performance figures. Once you have the north depot numbers, send them over and I'll draft it.
